implementation.storage: UTF-8 JSONL with fsync and OS file lock

validation.command: PYTHONPATH=. uv run --directory foundation_v2 pytest -q tests/test_owner_absence_journal.py tests/test_owner_absence_supervisor.py

known_limits: This is a persistence primitive, not a daemon or process supervisor.
Corrupt journals require explicit operator recovery; no auto-repair is attempted.
No live execution authority is represented or granted.
